item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02990","case1_error":"Treats each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correct expression 12 + 6 - 1 + 5 - 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"The first misrepresents the supplied quantity; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02991","case1_error":"Adds all three inches of growth to the 66-inch baseline chance, although final height exceeds that baseline by only two inches.","case2_error":"Evaluates 200 - 60 - 56 as 184 instead of 84.","reason":"The first uses the wrong baseline for the increase; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02992","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for the entire cat, omitting adjustment for two ears.","case2_error":"Treats 10 hours over five days as 10 hours per day, omitting adjustment for the five-day period.","reason":"Both assign a supplied time to the wrong unit basis, using it unchanged instead of converting between individual-unit and aggregate quantities.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02993","case1_error":"Omits the required $20 flat fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Includes an erroneous apples relation, then gives unsupported 110 after the correct adults formula, which yields 40.","reason":"The first omits a required additive component. The second contains an incorrect intermediate relation and an unsupported final number despite a correct final formula.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02994","case1_error":"Reverses the twice-as-many relationship, calculating Rosa's count as twice Emmy's instead of half.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 30 after correctly writing (32 + 13 + 15) - 20, which yields 40.","reason":"The first sets up the comparison incorrectly; the second states a wrong final number after a correct formula without showing its evaluation.","judgment":"different"}]}
